propositions: CLI transition close with an out-of-worktree REBAR_TRACKER_DIR falsely reports no referencing commit when the trailer exists in the current code worktree HEAD.

close_precheck._completion_precheck derives code_root as os.path.dirname(tracker), causing git log and completion-gate config to scan the tracker parent directory instead of the current code repository.
The defect permits silent unsigned closes when the tracker parent lacks gate config, or falsely rejects valid referencing commits when gate config exists only in the code repository.
code_root must be resolved through config.repo_root(repo_root) to scan the caller's current code checkout, independent of tracker relocation.
Completion-gate configuration and commit evidence scans must use the same code_root to prevent gate bypass and ensure deterministic close behavior.
